baseline: 04807e2 with only tree-retention source changes removed; same current search UI/core and fixture
method: Three alternating fresh desktop pairs. Three pre-diagnostic-GC snapshots and five post-diagnostic-renderer-GC samples per phase, medians within process then across three processes. No test suite/other benchmark run concurrently. Sources fingerprinted before/after.
scope: Six actual temporary project trees with 520 source files and 40 nested files each. Linux source Electron, not installer/peak RAM, VRAM, provider latency, or a general speed claim. Dirty text/history owners remain. Same-context navigation keeps trees warm. Extra correctness cases follow measured phases.
